text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft put on a fine performance in 
the Hanshin JF. She was delighted by the 
cheers of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal was set for the Fillies' 
Revue. To recover from the race's fatigue, 
she decided to take some rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, Line Craft caught sight of Daring 
Heart training. She looked completely worn 
out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even right after the race, Daring Heart 
pushes herself hard. Seeing this makes 
Rhein Kraft realize that she herself had 
become complacent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She needed to face racing more seriously. 
She threw herself into training for the 
Fillies' Revue.
